_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Dan wasa {player_id}, ka taka {num_rounds} zagaye na wasa na Iterated Ultimatum.
Ka riƙe $ {pool} don raba a zagaye na yanzu tsakanin kai da Dan wasa {other_id}.

Mai gabatar da shawara:
  - Yi shawara: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Idan aka karɓa → Ka samu $(pool - X), dan wasan wani ya samu $X
  - Idan aka ƙi → Dukkan su samu $0
  - Misali: [Offer: $3]  ko  'Ina ganin haka ne adalci. [Offer: $5]'

Mai amsa:
  - Kada shawara da [Accept] ko [Reject]
  - Misali: 'Haka ya dace. [Accept]'
            'Bai dace ba. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Zagaye {round_number} ya fara! ---
Dan wasa {proposer_id} ne mai gabatar da shawara, Dan wasa {responder_id} ne mai amsa.
round.offer: Zagaye {round_number}: Dan wasa {proposer_id} ya bayar $ {offer} ga Dan wasa {responder_id} (yana riƙe $ {keep}).
round.accepted: Dan wasa {responder_id} ya karɓa! Zagaye {round_number} nasara: Dan wasa {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, Dan wasa {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Jimlar sabo: Dan wasa 0: $ {total_0}, Dan wasa 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Dan wasa {responder_id} ya ƙi shawara! Zagaye {round_number} nasara: Dukkan dan wasa +$0. Jimlar ya tsaya: Dan wasa 0: $ {total_0}, Dan wasa 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Am do lamar shima dǝga fǝlezǝna ma so dәye awowa sǝdinma sodǝn faidatǝro format [Offer: $X] lan.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Adaduwa cinnabe dә lamba kalkallo waljin.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Awo do tәmoyin dә $0-a ${pool} lan kara.

outcome.win: Dan wasa {winner} ya yi nasara da $ {winner_total} jimlar vs Dan wasa {loser} $ {loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Kәla nduma indisoye ${total} samma so'a kәrmaza.
